set.tovw: Found: $537 in gold recovered from a bridle in the garret, Nov 1893
set.t: Recovered-find record. Private: permission. His grave is look-only.

tw-wi-glencoe-roland-1893.st: Recovered: a search of his premises found $537 in gold hidden in a bridle in the garret; the rest of his money had been taken or destroyed earlier.

tw-mi-agards-landing-gold.t: Landing stones on the river bank about a quarter mile below Maple Lake.
